title: Demographics
objective: Describe baseline demographic characteristics
method: Descriptive statistics

title: Subject disposition
objective: Describe randomisation completion and discontinuation
method: Counts and percentages

title: Exposure
objective: Describe observed treatment exposure
method: Descriptive statistics

title: TEAE overview
objective: Summarise treatment-emergent adverse events
endpoint: Any serious related and moderate/severe TEAE
method: Subject incidence and event counts

title: TEAE by SOC and PT
objective: Summarise TEAE incidence by medical category
endpoint: System organ class and preferred term
method: Unique-subject incidence

title: TEAE by severity
objective: Summarise TEAE incidence by severity
method: Unique-subject incidence

title: Any-TEAE risk difference
objective: Compare exploratory any-TEAE risk versus placebo
method: Risk difference Wald CI and Fisher exact test

title: ACTOT Week 24 descriptives
objective: Describe baseline Week 24 and change values
method: Descriptive statistics

title: ACTOT Week 24 ANCOVA LS means
objective: Estimate adjusted treatment means at Week 24
population: Observed Week 24 and LOCF sensitivity populations
method: ANCOVA with treatment and centred baseline

title: ACTOT Week 24 ANCOVA contrasts
objective: Compare active treatment with placebo at Week 24
population: Observed Week 24 and LOCF sensitivity populations
method: ANCOVA active-versus-placebo contrasts

title: ACTOT MMRM LS means
objective: Estimate adjusted ACTOT change by treatment and visit
method: REML MMRM with unstructured covariance and Satterthwaite df

title: ACTOT MMRM contrasts
objective: Compare active treatment with placebo by visit
method: Visit-specific MMRM contrasts with unstructured covariance

title: ACTOT MMRM covariance sensitivity
objective: Assess covariance-structure sensitivity
method: Unstructured versus heterogeneous AR(1) MMRM contrasts

title: MMRM model diagnostics
objective: Report repeated-measures model fit diagnostics
method: Log likelihood AIC and BIC by covariance model

title: Week 24 MMRM versus ANCOVA
objective: Compare longitudinal and Week 24-only estimates diagnostically
method: Side-by-side MMRM and observed-case ANCOVA contrasts

title: ACTOT missingness by visit
objective: Describe observed and missing ACTOT by arm and scheduled visit
population: Randomised subjects with observed baseline ACTOT
method: Counts percentages and discontinuation-linked decomposition

title: Week 24 missingness by disposition
objective: Describe recorded disposition context among subjects missing Week 24 ACTOT
population: Randomised subjects with observed baseline ACTOT and missing Week 24 ACTOT
method: Counts and percentages of missing subjects by disposition category

title: ACTOT fixed-delta MNAR sensitivity
objective: Stress the primary Week 24 MMRM contrast under fixed location shifts for missing outcomes
population: Randomised subjects with observed baseline ACTOT
method: Fixed-delta pattern-mixture mean-shift diagnostic across three adverse scenarios

title: ACTOT directional tipping points
objective: Quantify the adverse delta required for each active-versus-placebo point estimate to reach zero
population: Randomised subjects with observed baseline ACTOT
method: Analytic direction-of-effect tipping point with grid bracketing

title: ACTOT rbmi MAR pairwise MI
objective: Quantify subject-level imputation uncertainty for Week 24 active-versus-placebo contrasts
population: Randomised subjects with observed baseline ACTOT
method: Approximate-Bayesian rbmi MI with Week 24 baseline-adjusted ANCOVA and Rubin pooling

title: ACTOT rbmi delta MI sensitivity
objective: Assess MAR departures using controlled Week 24 delta adjustments with MI uncertainty
population: Randomised subjects with observed baseline ACTOT
method: Approximate-Bayesian rbmi MI plus active and divergent delta scenarios with Rubin pooling

title: ACTOT rbmi reference-based MI sensitivity
objective: Assess treatment-discontinuation departures using MAR JR CR and CIR with a placebo reference distribution
population: Randomised subjects with observed baseline ACTOT
method: Approximate-Bayesian rbmi reference-based MI with EOSDT-aligned ICE timing Week 24 ANCOVA Rubin pooling and MCSE QC

title: ACTOT Week 24 multiplicity decisions
objective: Apply the planned Bonferroni family-wise decision rule to the two primary Week 24 active-versus-placebo MMRM contrasts
method: Bonferroni FWER 0.05 across two primary active-versus-placebo hypotheses

title: Study-discontinuation Kaplan-Meier retention
objective: Describe retention without study discontinuation at prespecified days
population: Randomised treated subjects in the three study arms
endpoint: Time from first treatment to study discontinuation
method: Kaplan-Meier retention estimates at days 56 112 168 and 182 with log-log 95% confidence intervals

title: Study-discontinuation pairwise survival diagnostics
objective: Compare active treatment retention with placebo exploratorily
population: Randomised treated subjects in the three study arms
endpoint: Time from first treatment to study discontinuation
method: Exploratory pairwise log-rank tests and Cox proportional-hazards models with Efron ties plus cox.zph diagnostics
